description: Java class implementing a service for invoking JavaScript code using Nashorn sandbox or engine, managing script evaluation, invocation, and lifecycle within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: NashornJsInvokeService
classes.description: Service class for executing JavaScript code via Nashorn sandbox or engine, with lifecycle and script management.

methods.name: getStatsName
methods.description: Returns the name used for statistics reporting.

methods.name: getCallbackExecutor
methods.description: Provides the executor for callback execution, using direct executor.

methods.name: printStats
methods.description: Scheduled method to print current statistics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting up sandbox or engine based on configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down executor services and cleans up resources.

methods.name: doEval
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript script asynchronously, handling sandbox or engine execution.

methods.name: doInvokeFunction
methods.description: Invokes a JavaScript function asynchronously with provided arguments.

methods.name: doRelease
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a script, setting its function to undefined.
